parameters.query:
select c.id as contact_id, c.phone, c.name, c.customer_status,
       cv.id as conversation_id,
       (select count(*) from public.policies p where p.contact_id = c.id and p.status='active') as active_policies,
       (select policy_number from public.policies p where p.contact_id = c.id and p.status='active' order by p.created_at desc limit 1) as last_policy_number,
       (select i.name from public.policies p join public.insurers i on i.id = p.insurer_id where p.contact_id = c.id and p.status='active' order by p.created_at desc limit 1) as last_insurer_name,
       (select coalesce(sum(pm.amount),0) from public.payments pm join public.policies p on p.id=pm.policy_id where p.contact_id=c.id and pm.status in ('pending','overdue')) as balance_due,
       (select id from public.claims where contact_id = c.id and status not in ('closed','rejected') order by reported_at desc limit 1) as open_claim_id
from public.conversations cv
join public.contacts c on c.id = cv.contact_id
where cv.id = $1;

nodes.name: Obtener contexto del cliente
nodes.notes: Recopila lo que ya se sabe ANTES de escalar — Nairobi no debe empezar de cero (ARCHITECTURE.md §HUMAN_REQUIRED).

parameters.query: select message_text as body, direction, created_at from public.messages where conversation_id = $1 order by created_at desc limit 10;

nodes.name: Armar paquete de escalación
nodes.notes: Formato exacto del paquete ESCALACIÓN documentado en ARCHITECTURE.md §HUMAN_REQUIRED — Nairobi recibe algo ya organizado, no un problema en blanco. FIX 2026-08-16 (Vision, D011): ctx.full_name→ctx.name, ctx.chat_id→ctx.phone, ctx.lifecycle→ctx.customer_status (columnas reales de public.contacts).

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.conversation_id, $json.contact_id, $json.reason, $json.urgency, JSON.stringify({ last_policy_number: $json.last_policy_number, last_insurer_name: $json.last_insurer_name, balance_due: $json.balance_due, open_claim_id: $json.open_claim_id, context_summary: $json.context_summary }), $json.summary] }}

parameters.query: update public.conversations set should_respond = false, status = 'escalated' where id = $1;

nodes.name: Kill switch: should_respond = false
nodes.notes: FIX 2026-08-16 (Vision, D011): bot_enabled (no existe) → should_respond=false + status='escalated' (columnas/enum reales de public.conversations). Se reactiva solo cuando Nairobi resuelve la escalación desde la app web (W8 → escalation-resolve). Evita que Nai siga interviniendo mientras Nairobi atiende el caso en persona.

nodes.name: Evaluar horario real
nodes.notes: Reemplaza la condición simplificada del IF anterior con la lógica real (emergency O dentro de horario). 'Noche + no emergencia' → notify_now=false → queda en la cola para el digest de las 08:00 (W7), tal como especifica ARCHITECTURE.md §Humanidad nocturna.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ number: ($json.nairobi_chat_id || '').toString().replace(/\D/g, ''), text: $('Armar paquete de escalación').item.json.summary }) }}

nodes.name: Notificar a Nairobi (Evolution)
nodes.notes: Migrado de WaAPI a Evolution API v2 el 2026-08-23 (R014). Endpoint /message/sendText/{instancia}, body {number, text} — el número va en dígitos, sin @c.us. Credencial 'Evolution API saliente' (header apikey). JSON.stringify evita romper el body con comillas o saltos de línea.

parameters.query: update public.escalations set notified_at = now() where id = (select id from public.escalations order by created_at desc limit 1);

nodes.name: Marcar notified_at
nodes.notes: Simplificado con 'order by created_at desc limit 1' porque n8n no encadena bien el id entre ramas paralelas aquí; al formalizar en la UI real de n8n, preferir pasar explícitamente el id devuelto por 'Insertar escalación' vía referencia de nodo en vez de este subquery.
